title: After $100M cut, Naples estate returns at $195M; why the luxury home remains unsold
summary_full: Gordon Pointe, a Naples waterfront estate, is now listed for $195 million. This price represents a $100 million reduction from its initial listing. The property was assembled over decades by financier John Donahue. Its location offers extensive beach frontage and a private yacht basin. The estate remains one of the nation's most expensive homes.
